claim: PLAIN: Dhruv's ideal Trotter step is 12 copies of the same 3-qubit 'hopping' operation (each perfect at 4 entangling MS gates) plus 6 tiny 2-qubit on-site ones (1 MS each), total 54 -- which our incumbent already hits exactly. EXP-0002 (prune one block 4->3 in isolation) and EXP-0003 (drop a 4th MS and let neighbors' single-qubit angles compensate) both died: the 4th MS carries irreducible two-qubit entangling content that single-qubit angles cannot manufacture. The ONLY door left open for beating 54 is a genuinely STRUCTURAL saving: two hopping blocks that are CONSECUTIVE in the frozen application order AND share a qubit are, on their combined 5-qubit support, just one honest 5-qubit unitary -- and a 5-qubit unitary built from two structured hopping blocks may be exactly synthesizable in 7 MS rather than 4+4=8, because the shared qubit lets entangling content be reused across the seam instead of paid for twice. If ONE such pair compresses 8 MS -> 7 MS at the fidelity bar, the whole step drops to 53 MS. FORMAL: enumerate the frozen block order in target.ideal_step; find hopping-block pairs (b1,b2) that share >=1 qubit and have NO intervening block touching supp(b1) U supp(b2) between them (so their ordered product on the combined support is exact); form U_joint = the ordered product of the two block unitaries on those 4-or-5 qubits; run target.fit_block(U_joint, joint_qubits, n_ms=7); if the best such fit yields FULL-circuit state-averaged mean infidelity <= 1e-4 with margin when the 7-MS joint subcircuit replaces the two 4-MS subcircuits (all other blocks untouched), ship the resulting 53-MS circuit. This is Director lane 3 (structural cross-block merging), exactly the pair-level 8->7 probe that EXP-0003's reopen condition priced open -- NOT approximate pruning (EXP-0002) and NOT single-qubit-angle compensation (EXP-0003).
prediction: At least one qualifying consecutive qubit-sharing hopping pair exists in the frozen order, and its joint 4-or-5-qubit unitary fits an n_ms=7 native ansatz such that the assembled full circuit has state-averaged mean infidelity <= 5e-5 (comfortably under the 1e-4 bar) at ms_count=53, is_native=True -- a strictly-better valid circuit than the 54-MS incumbent, promoting to 53.
falsifier: No qualifying pair beats the bar: either (a) the frozen order contains no two hopping blocks that share a qubit with no intervening block on their combined support, or (b) every such pair's best n_ms=7 joint fit leaves the assembled full circuit's offline mean infidelity > 1e-4. Then 8->7 pairwise merge is infeasible and 53 via this mechanism is impossible.
kill_threshold: If the falsifier fires (best qualifying-pair full-circuit offline infidelity > 1e-4, i.e. no valid 53-MS circuit), below-54 via pairwise structural merge is DEAD. Ship the exact 54-MS incumbent (WIN retained: matches Dhruv's 9N=54 at ~1e-13). Combined with EXP-0002/EXP-0003 this exhausts the below-54 stretch and directs consolidation to the honest-null: publish the certified 54-MS bound, do NOT claim his 36% was suboptimal.
brief:
Edit ONLY workspace/candidate.py. It MUST define build_circuit() -> list of native gate tuples and be SELF-CONTAINED (scored as a copy in experiments/ where target/baseline/incumbent are NOT importable; numpy allowed). Do all probing in the workspace where target IS importable, then FREEZE the resulting gate list into build_circuit.

STEP 1 (rebuild the 54-MS incumbent): using target primitives, build the exact incumbent gate list -- 12 hopping blocks each realized by fit_block(target.HOP_UNITARY, target.hop_qubits(b), n_ms=4) remapped to hop_qubits(b), and 6 on-site blocks each realized as the known 1-MS fit fit_block(target.INT_UNITARY, target.int_qubits(i), n_ms=1). Confirm target.is_native==True, target.ms_count==54, target.estimate_infidelity <= 1e-4 (expect ~1e-13). This is your safe fallback.

STEP 2 (enumerate the seam candidates): read target.py to recover the EXACT frozen application order of all blocks in ideal_step and the qubit index sets hop_qubits(b)/int_qubits(i). Find every pair of hopping blocks (b1,b2) such that: (a) they share >=1 qubit, and (b) NO other block (hopping OR on-site) acts on any qubit in supp(b1) U supp(b2) at any position strictly between b1 and b2 in the frozen order. Condition (b) guarantees the ordered product on the combined support is exact with no intervening interaction. List all qualifying pairs and their combined qubit supports (4 qubits if they share 2, 5 if they share 1).

STEP 3 (joint fit): for each qualifying pair, compute U_joint = the ordered product (respecting frozen order) of the two 3-qubit block unitaries embedded on the combined support. Run target.fit_block(U_joint, joint_qubits, n_ms=7) and record its residual mean infidelity. Keep the pair with the smallest residual.

STEP 4 (assemble + full certify): for the best pair, build the FULL circuit = incumbent with b1's and b2's two 4-MS subcircuits removed and replaced by the single 7-MS joint subcircuit (on joint_qubits, inserted at b1's position; all other blocks unchanged). Verify target.is_native==True, target.ms_count==53, and target.estimate_infidelity over MANY (>= 4000) random states spanning all three battery kinds (Haar, random-product, computational-basis) is <= 5e-5 (margin under 1e-4). Do NOT tune toward any specific state distribution -- certify against U_ideal only (over-fit guard).

STEP 5 (freeze decision): IF step 4 passes at <= 5e-5 -> freeze that 53-MS gate list into build_circuit(). IF NO qualifying pair reaches <= 5e-5 in the full-circuit check (or no qualifying pair exists) -> freeze the exact 54-MS incumbent gate list from step 1 into build_circuit(), with a one-line comment that the 8->7 stretch probe failed. NEVER submit a circuit whose own offline infidelity exceeds 5e-5 -- that avoids shipping an INVALID candidate. build_circuit() returns hardcoded/frozen numeric gate tuples; no import of target/baseline/incumbent at scoring time.
done_definition: workspace/candidate.py defines a self-contained build_circuit() returning a native gate list (numpy allowed, no target/baseline/incumbent import). Either: (WIN-STRETCH) a frozen 53-MS circuit with is_native=True, ms_count=53, and offline estimate_infidelity <= 5e-5 across all three battery kinds; OR (FALLBACK) the exact frozen 54-MS incumbent with is_native=True, ms_count=54, offline infidelity ~1e-13. In both cases the diff touches only candidate.py.
reopen_condition: If this dies (no qualifying consecutive qubit-sharing hopping pair achieves full-circuit offline infidelity <= 1e-4 at 53 MS), below-54 reopens ONLY via a strictly LARGER exact structural unit, demonstrated feasible in an offline probe on my own random states BEFORE any submission: either (i) a consecutive, mutually-qubit-sharing hopping TRIPLE (three blocks whose combined support has no intervening block) whose joint unitary fits fit_block(U_joint, joint_qubits, n_ms=11) at residual <= 1e-4 (12 MS -> 11), OR (ii) an adjacent overlapping hopping-block/on-site-block pair (sharing >=1 qubit, no intervening block on their combined support) whose joint unitary compresses its combined MS by exactly 1 at residual <= 1e-4. Priced: enumerate the frozen order for the qualifying multi-block unit and run one joint fit, ~1 coder cycle. If neither probe shows <= 1e-4, the below-54 stretch is exhausted -> consolidate to the honest-null 54-MS bound.
